title: Culture of Established Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell Lines
author: Cellular Generation and Phenotyping
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgbwjspe

steps.title: Coat plate and prepare media
steps.instruction: Coat each 6‑well plate with vitronectin and incubate according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Prepare complete E8 or TeSR‑E8 culture medium as directed by the supplier.

steps.title: Prepare thawing media with ROCK inhibitor
steps.instruction: Supplement the complete culture medium with the ROCK inhibitor Y‑27632 to a final concentration of 10 µM. Add 8 mL of this thawing media per cryovial into sterile 15 mL Falcon tube(s).

steps.title: Thaw cryovials and add thawing media
steps.instruction: Place frozen iPSC cryovials in a 37 °C water bath and thaw until only a small ice crystal remains. Add 1 mL of thawing media dropwise to each cryovial, then transfer the entire cell suspension into the corresponding Falcon tube. Keep cells as small clumps and minimise pipetting.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cells for plating
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Falcon tubes at 120 rcf (120 × g) for 3 min at room temperature. Aspirate the vitronectin from the coated well surface and immediately add 1 mL thawing media per well (do not let the surface dry). Aspirate the supernatant, gently resuspend each cell pellet in 1 mL thawing media, and plate the suspension into the corresponding well.

steps.title: Plate cells and incubate for attachment
steps.instruction: Agitate the plate gently inside a tissue‑culture incubator set to 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to distribute cells evenly. Allow cells to attach for 2–24 h without disturbance.

steps.title: First media change to remove inhibitor
steps.instruction: Twenty‑four hours after plating, perform a full media change with fresh complete E8/TeSR‑E8 medium (no ROCK inhibitor).

steps.title: Daily media changes until confluency
steps.instruction: Change the culture medium every 24 h with complete E8/TeSR‑E8 until colonies reach 70–80 % confluency; then proceed to passage.

steps.title: Prepare fresh 0.5 mM EDTA
steps.instruction: Dilute UltraPure 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0) with DPBS(‑/‑) to obtain a 0.5 mM solution. Store at room temperature and use the same day.

steps.title: EDTA treatment and colony observation
steps.instruction: Aspirate spent medium and wash each well with 2 mL DPBS(‑/‑). Aspirate DPBS and add 1–2 mL 0.5 mM EDTA per well, rock the plate to cover the cells and incubate 4 min at room temperature. Observe colonies under a microscope until shiny “halos” appear around the edges and holes develop throughout the colonies.

steps.title: Collect cells for passaging
steps.instruction: Aspirate the EDTA solution and add 2 mL culture medium per well. Gently dispense medium across the surface up to three times to detach cells; if colonies remain attached, repeat the wash with fresh medium. Avoid creating bubbles. Collect the detached cells into a Falcon tube.

steps.title: Coat new plate and reseed cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate vitronectin from the new 6‑well plate(s) and replace with 1 mL pre‑warmed complete culture medium (do not let dry). Add culture medium to the cell suspension to achieve the desired split ratio (aim for passage every 4–5 days, adjusting as needed). Plate 1 mL of the suspension into each well and agitate gently in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator for even distribution.

steps.title: Prepare freezing media (10 % DMSO in KSR)
steps.instruction: Make fresh freezing medium containing 10 % DMSO in KSR (e.g., 1 mL DMSO + 9 mL KSR). Store at 4 °C until use.

steps.title: EDTA treatment for freezing
steps.instruction: Aspirate spent medium from the confluent well and wash with 2 mL DPBS(‑/‑). Aspirate DPBS and add 2 mL 0.5 mM EDTA per well, rock to cover the surface and incubate 4–8 min at room temperature. Observe colonies until shiny halos and holes appear.

steps.title: Collect cells for freezing
steps.instruction: Aspirate the EDTA solution and add 2 mL culture medium per well. Gently wash the surface with medium up to three times; if >50 % of colonies remain attached, repeat the wash. Avoid bubbles and collect the cells into an appropriate Falcon tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Falcon tube at 120 rcf (120 × g) for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend in freezing media
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in enough freezing media (prepared in step 12) to obtain a total volume of 1 mL per cryovial.

steps.title: Aliquot and freeze cells
steps.instruction: Dispense 1 mL of the cell suspension into each cryovial. Place the vials in a CoolCell (or equivalent) and store at –80 °C, transferring them to the freezer as quickly as possible.

steps.title: Transfer to liquid nitrogen storage
steps.instruction: After 24–48 h at –80 °C, move the cryovials from the CoolCell into liquid‑nitrogen storage for indefinite preservation.

steps.title: Prepare fresh EDTA for future use
steps.instruction: Dilute UltraPure 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0) with DPBS(‑/‑) to 0.5 mM, store at room temperature, and use on the day of preparation.
